sentences.text:
For the Petitioner : Mr. Ajit Kumar, Advocate For the Respondents : Mr. Vishal
Kumar Rai, Ac. to G.A.-Iv Order No. 07 Dated: 09.08.2023

The present writ petition has been filed for issuance of direction upon the District Land Acquisition Officer, Ranchi-cum- Competent Authority under the National Highways Act, 1956 (the respondent no. 3) to re-determine the compensation amount with respect to acquisition of the land appertaining to R.S. Plot Nos. 2473,
2485, 2488 and 2491, Khata No. 78, Mouza- Birgaon-III, P.S. Tamar, District- Ranchi measuring total area of 0.22 acre and to pay the balance amount of compensation within a specified period.
2.

After some argument, learned counsel for the petitioner prays for withdrawal of the present writ petition with liberty to the petitioner to raise his subsisting grievance before the respondent no. 3.
3.
Considering the said prayer, the writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with aforesaid liberty.
